title: IPO Form Definition
description: Generic, form-agnostic definition schema capable of representing every Indian Patent Office (IPO) form documented in docs/specifications/. A form-definition document that validates against this schema fully describes one form's sections, fields, tables, choices, conditional logic, validation, signature blocks, repeatable rows and auto-fill hints — without any UI, rendering or backend code. Governing product principle: the software SUGGESTS, the user DECIDES. Auto-fill hints describe opportunity only; a value is never locked and every field is always editable.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS definition schema the document targets.

formId.description: Stable machine id, matching the spec file stem, e.g. "form_03", "form_18a".

formNumber.description: Official form number as printed, kept as a string to allow variants, e.g. "3", "7A", "18A".

officialName.description: Exact official name transcribed from the PDF.

sections.description: Ordered sections. Array order IS the printed order.

constraints.description: Form-level cross-field constraints (e.g. exactly-one-of, at-least-one-of, custom cross-field asserts).

attachments.description: Documents the form requires or references as enclosures.

notes.description: Verbatim footnotes / special notes from the form (strike-out instructions, warnings, fee notes).

metadata.description: Free-form provenance/authoring metadata (source PDF, transcriber, revision date). Not consumed by rendering.

identifier.description: snake/kebab id, unique within its scope. Field paths join ids with dots (see README).

model.description: "first_schedule" = fee per the First Schedule; "none" = no fee on the form face (e.g. Form 27 "No Fee"); "stamp_duty" = stamped instrument (e.g. Form 26); "other" = see note.

dependsOn.description: Factors the fee scales with, e.g. ["applicant_category", "claim_count", "page_count"] for Form 1.

columns.description: Printed column count of the form face (many IPO forms are 2-column label/content tables).

helpText.description: Guidance surfaced with the section (e.g. the left-column instruction printed beside a numbered row).

officeUseOnly.description: True for "FOR OFFICE USE ONLY" blocks: reproduce on preview but read-only for the filer.

kind.description: Field kind. checkbox=single boolean; checkboxGroup=several individually-addressable checkboxes (multi-select); radio/dropdown=single-select; strikeoutChoice=single-select whose unchosen option(s) are struck through on export; group/signatureBlock=containers of nested fields; table=columns + repeatable rows; boilerplate=static pre-printed text (no input).

format.description: Semantic format hint (open vocabulary). Recommended values: email, phone, applicationNumber, patentNumber, pincode, aadhaar, country, patentOffice, financialYear, currency, ipc, address.

selection.description: For choice kinds. radio/dropdown/strikeoutChoice => single; checkboxGroup => multiple.

cell.description: A table cell is a scalar field (no nested tables or groups).

repeatable.description: Marks a field (typically group or table) or its rows as repeatable. Applied to a group => the whole block repeats (e.g. applicant block (a)-(c)). Applied to a table => rows repeat.

itemLabel.description: Singular label for one instance, e.g. "Applicant", "Inventor", "Foreign application".

condition.description: Boolean expression over field values. Used by visibleWhen/requiredWhen/enabledWhen and by constraints. A leaf references another field by its dotted path (see README). For multi-select fields, op "in" tests membership of a value within the selection.

field.description: Dotted path of the referenced field.

validation.description: Intrinsic (single-field) validators. Cross-field checks belong in section/form constraints.

min.description: Numeric minimum, or a date (ISO) / date-token for date fields.

notFuture.description: Date must not be in the future.

constraint.description: A cross-field rule. Attach at group/section/form level.

type.description: Set-style rules operate on `fields`; "custom" evaluates the `assert` condition.

fields.description: Dotted field paths the set-style rule ranges over.

when.description: Guard: rule only applies when this holds.

assert.description: For type=custom: the condition that must hold.

autofill.description: How this field COULD be pre-filled from uploaded documents. Advisory only — the value is never locked and the user may always override (product principle: software suggests, user decides). `sources[].key` is an abstract semantic pointer into the internal extraction object; the concrete extraction schema is intentionally NOT bound here (it is still being modelled).

strategy.description: direct = copy a value from a source; derived = computed/inferred (see derivation); manual = user must enter (no auto source).

derivation.description: Human-readable description of the derivation for strategy=derived.

sourceType.description: Origin document/type (open vocabulary). Recommended: form1, form2_specification, form5, form26_authorisation, form28, patent_certificate, priority_document, pct_document, assignment_document, publication_record.

key.description: Semantic key within the source (open vocabulary), e.g. applicant.name, invention.title, application.number, application.filingDate, patent.number, patent.grantDate, agent.inpaNumber, foreignApplications[].country.

sensitive.description: Flags personal/sensitive data handling requirements observed on the form (e.g. Form 1 OTP fields, Form 8A Aadhaar, Form 18A female photo ID).

export.description: Hints for reproducing the field on the exported/preview form so it matches the official layout.

strikeoutUnselected.description: For strikeoutChoice: strike through the option(s) not chosen.

presentation.description: Light, renderer-agnostic layout hints. NOT UI code — just ordering/grouping metadata.

group.description: Free tag to visually group sibling fields.
